scope: Vietnam terrestrial mobile numbers (10 national digits, leading 0). Lists allocated number blocks only: a block says the number FORMAT is in an allocated mobile range, never that the subscriber exists, is active, or is still on that operator (number portability is allowed).
matching: A national number (0 + 9 digits) is allocated when it starts with any listed prefix. A prefix may have 3 or more digits when only part of a 3-digit range is allocated; prefixes must not overlap.

matchingDecisionRule: A prefix is ACCEPTED only when its allocation (phân bổ) to an operator is evidenced. Three stages are kept apart: (1) won at auction, (2) allocated by decision of the Ministry/Cục Viễn thông, (3) in operation. A prefix at stage 1 only is NOT accepted: nobody can hold a subscriber on it yet, and a wrong rejection is fixed by moving the prefix to `prefixes` and regenerating. The cost of a wrong acceptance would only be one wasted SMS (bounded by the OTP quotas), so the Owner may decide to accept earlier; that is a business decision recorded here, not made by the code.

pendingPrefixes.basis: Viettel won the auction of mã mạng 95 on 2026-07-10 (252.5 tỷ đồng, organised by VPA; plan: Quyết định 1845/QĐ-BKHCN 2026-03-20, Thông báo 2592/TB-CVT 2026-06-19). The block was S-Fone's, closed in 2016. Press reports say Viettel will put it into service after the regulatory procedures; the winner has at most 6 months after allocation to start operating. No allocation decision number and no in-service confirmation was found, so it is not accepted. HIGH PRIORITY: it is the most likely to be in service soon; confirm on vnta.gov.vn and move to `prefixes` when allocated.

Vietnam Post announced on 2026-10-15 that it won the auction of mã mạng H2H 75 (plan: Quyết định 3366/QĐ-BKHCN 2026-08-04; Thông báo 3795/TB-CVT 2026-08-20; reported price 2.75 tỷ đồng from one source only). The announcement says the remaining procedures must still be completed before the prefix is put into operation, so it is only at the auction stage: not allocated, not in service, not accepted. 075 was formerly Bến Tre's fixed-line code (now 0275). Move to `prefixes` when the allocation is evidenced.
